scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of National Fellowship for Providing Fellowship to Scheduled Caste Students to Pursue M.Phil. & PhD
other_conditions: Must be a regular full‑time student pursuing an M.Phil or Ph.D.
Must have qualified UGC NET‑JRF or UGC‑CSIR NET‑JRF joint test
Must be enrolled in a university/institution recognized by UGC (including central/state universities, deemed universities, or institutions of national importance)
Can hold only one fellowship at a time and must not receive any other monetary benefit
Candidates with prior admission must join the fellowship within 3 months of the JRF award letter; otherwise selection is based on NET merit
For disability reservation, a minimum of 40 % disability is required
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly fellowship of Rs 31,000 (JRF) or Rs 35,000 (SRF) along with allowances for eligible SC candidates pursuing M.Phil/Ph.D.
